notes: Foundation catalog. Visual animation components are added as each development-plan part is implemented and tested. Do not mark entries tested until automated checks pass.

components.name: QUONITRON Dark Theme
components.description: Default premium dark editorial theme: semantic colors, type hierarchy, spacing, stroke, and motion tokens used by all later components.
components.example:
from quonitron.design import get_theme
theme = get_theme()
bg = theme.color('background')
components.limitations: Does not render pixels by itself. Font names are fallbacks; exact glyph metrics vary by OS.

components.name: Base Component
components.description: Theme-aware base class and metadata contract for reusable animation components. Visual subclasses are added in later parts.

theme.description: Optional theme override. Defaults to the registered default theme.

components.example:
from quonitron.components import BaseComponent
comp = BaseComponent()
comp.ensure_built()
components.limitations: Not a Manim VGroup. Later visual components may wrap or compose VGroups.
